title: AceMines
description: This plugin adds configurable mines to your minecraft server
body:
# ⛏️ AceMines

Create and manage ultra-configurable mines on your Minecraft server. AceMines gives you complete control over block composition, automated resets, and more.

---

## ✨ Features

* **⏳ Dynamic Respawn System:** Choose between an instant mine reset or multiple custom cooldowns based on the current player count (e.g., 30 seconds for 20+ Players and 10 seconds for 50+ Players)
* **💎 Precise Block Composition:** Configure multiple block types within your mine, each with its own exact percentage chance to appear.
* **🔥 Integrated Auto-Smelt:** Toggle whether ores are automatically smelted into their refined forms the exact moment a player mines them.
* **📦 Inventory Drop:** Choose whether mined resources drop naturally on the ground or get sent directly into the player's inventory.
* **⚡ Auto-Compress System:** Automatically compress mined resources into their block forms (e.g., instantly turning 9 Diamonds into 1 Diamond Block) to save inventory space.
* **🔔 Immersive Reset Alerts:** Announce mine resets with a custom chat message and a sound effect that plays within a configurable block distance.
